common.tagline: Your Gateway to Indian Medical Excellence
common.footer_reason: You are receiving this email because of activity on your {app_name} account.
common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Verify your email for {app_name}
verify.title: Verify your email
verify.heading: Confirm your email address
verify.intro: Thanks for joining {app_name}. Please confirm your email address to secure your account.
verify.expiry: This link expires in {hours} hours. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your {app_name} password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your {app_name} account.
reset.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once. If you did not request a reset, no action is needed - your password stays the same.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.heading: You have been invited
invite.body_org_role: {inviter} invited you to join {organization} on {app_name} as {role}.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.body: The password for your account was just changed. If this was not you, reset your password immediately and contact support.

hospital_member_added.subject: You have been added to {hospital}
hospital_member_added.title: You now have access to {hospital}
hospital_member_added.body: {inviter} added you to {hospital} as {role}. Sign in to the hospital portal to get started.

user_registered.title: Welcome to Heal India Global
user_registered.body_patient: Start with a free AI screening to get matched with accredited Indian hospitals and doctors, compare costs and request quotes.
user_registered.body_agent: Complete your agency profile and upload your KYC documents. Once approved you can add patients, request quotes and track your commissions.
user_registered.body_hospital: Complete your hospital profile, add doctors and procedures, upload KYC documents and submit for review to start receiving international enquiries.

hospital_approved.title: {hospital} is now live
hospital_approved.body: Your hospital has been approved and is now visible to international patients.

hospital_rejected.title: {hospital}: application needs changes
hospital_rejected.body: Your hospital application was not approved.
hospital_rejected.resubmit: Please review your profile and documents and resubmit.

agent_approved.title: Your agency has been approved
agent_approved.body: {agency} is approved. You can now add patients, request quotes and earn commissions.

agent_rejected.title: Your agency application was not approved
agent_rejected.body: The application for {agency} was not approved.

screening.emergency_title: Important: please seek urgent medical care
screening.emergency_body: Your answers suggest symptoms that may need immediate attention. Please contact your local emergency services or nearest hospital now rather than planning travel.
screening.failed_title: We could not complete your screening
screening.failed_body: Something went wrong while analysing your answers. Please try again or contact support.
screening.ready_body: We have matched you with hospitals and doctors for your condition. View your top matches.

case_created.title: New enquiry {case_number}
case_created.body: {patient} has requested a treatment quote. Review the case and send a quote.

case_declined.title: Case {case_number} declined by the hospital
case_declined.body: {hospital} is unable to take case {case_number}. Your coordinator can help you find another hospital.

quote_sent.title: New quote from {hospital}
quote_sent.body: {hospital} sent a treatment quote for case {case_number}.

quote_accepted.title: Quote accepted for {case_number}
quote_accepted.next: The booking and payment will follow.

booking_confirmed.title: Booking {booking_number} confirmed
booking_confirmed.hospital_body: The booking of {patient} is confirmed (deposit received).

booking_admitted.title: Admitted at {hospital}
booking_admitted.body: Admission for booking {booking_number} is confirmed. Wishing you a smooth treatment and recovery.

booking_completed.title: Treatment completed
booking_completed.body: Your treatment at {hospital} (booking {booking_number}) is complete. We wish you a speedy recovery - please share a review of your experience.
booking_completed.hospital_body: The patient has been discharged. The settlement for this booking will be scheduled after the hold period.

booking_cancelled.title: Booking {booking_number} cancelled
booking_cancelled.refund: A refund of {amount} will be processed to the original payment method.

payment_captured.title: Payment received
payment_captured.thanks: Thank you - a receipt is available in your account.

payment_failed.title: Payment failed
payment_failed.body: Your payment of {amount} (order {order_number}) did not go through. No money was taken; please try again or choose another payment method.

refund_processed.title: Refund processed
refund_processed.body: A refund of {amount} has been processed.
refund_processed.body_booking: A refund of {amount} for booking {booking_number} has been processed.
refund_processed.timing: It may take 5-10 business days to appear on your statement.

payout_processed.title: Payout sent
payout_processed.body: A payout of {amount} has been sent to your bank account.

payout_failed.title: Payout failed
payout_failed.body: Your payout of {amount} could not be completed.
payout_failed.next: Please check your payout account details; our finance team will retry.

sos_updated.acknowledged_body: Our support team has seen your SOS and is handling it. Keep your phone with you.
sos_updated.acknowledged_body_named: {name} from our support team has seen your SOS and is handling it. Keep your phone with you.
sos_updated.resolved_body: Our support team marked your emergency alert as resolved. If you still need help, send a new SOS or call the 24/7 helpline.

screening_emergency_staff.title: Urgent: possible emergency for {patient}
screening_emergency_staff.body: A screening for {patient} was flagged as a possible medical emergency. The patient has been told to seek local emergency care. Please contact them now.

travel_status.title: Travel update for case {case_number}
travel_status.visa_applied_body: Your medical visa application has been submitted for case {case_number}.

statuses.invitation_issued: has an invitation letter from the hospital
statuses.rejected: was not approved. Your coordinator will help you with next steps
statuses.quoted: has a price quote ready for you to review

consultation_scheduled.title: Consultation scheduled for case {num}
consultation_scheduled.body: Your tele-consultation with {doctor} is scheduled for {when}. The joining link is in the case.

consultation_rescheduled.title: Consultation changed for case {num}
consultation_rescheduled.body: Your tele-consultation with {doctor} has changed. New time: {when}. Check the case for the current joining link.

consultation_cancelled.title: Consultation cancelled for case {num}
consultation_cancelled.body: The tele-consultation with {doctor} for case {num} has been cancelled. You can request a new one from the case.

coordinator_assigned.title: Your coordinator for case {case_number}
coordinator_assigned.body: {name} from Heal India Global is now your care coordinator. Message them from the case any time.
coordinator_assigned.coordinator_body: You have been assigned as the coordinator for {patient} (case {case_number}).

quote_rejected.title: Quote declined for {case_number}
quote_rejected.next: You can send a revised quote.

quote_expired.hospital_body: Your quote for case {case_number} passed its validity date without being accepted. Send a new quote if the patient still needs treatment.
quote_expired.title: Your quote from {hospital} has expired
quote_expired.body: The quote for case {case_number} is no longer valid. Ask the hospital or your coordinator for a new quote.

installment_due.title: Payment reminder
installment_due.body_today: Instalment {seq} of {amount} for booking {booking_number} is due today.
installment_due.body_date: Instalment {seq} of {amount} for booking {booking_number} is due on {date}.

installment_overdue.title: Payment overdue
installment_overdue.body: Instalment {seq} of {amount} for booking {booking_number} was due on {date} and is still unpaid. Please pay it or talk to your coordinator.

settlement_batch_pending.title: Settlement batch {batch_number} needs approval
settlement_batch_pending.body: A {payee_type} settlement batch of {count} items ({amount} net) is waiting for a second approver.

quote_reminder_due.title: Quote due soon for case {case_number}
quote_reminder_due.body: The patient is waiting for your quote. Please send it within {hours} hours (by {when}).

quote_overdue.hospital_body: The quote promised to the patient is overdue. Please send it now.
quote_overdue.coordinator_body: The hospital has not sent a quote in time. Please follow up with the hospital.
quote_overdue.patient_title: We're chasing the hospital for your quote
quote_overdue.patient_body: Your quote for case {case_number} is taking longer than promised. Our team is following up with the hospital and will update you soon.

aftercare_red_flag.title: URGENT: recovery warning signs, case {case_number}
aftercare_red_flag.body: The patient reported {flags} in their day-{day} check-in. Please contact the patient now.
aftercare_red_flag.patient_title: Your care team has been alerted
aftercare_red_flag.patient_body: Thank you for your check-in. Your hospital and our coordinator have been told and will contact you. If you feel very unwell, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital now.

consultation_reminder.patient_title_soon: Your video consultation starts in 1 hour
consultation_reminder.patient_body: Your consultation is at {when}. Join from the app using the video link.
consultation_reminder.hospital_body: A video consultation is scheduled at {when}.
consultation_reminder.intro_title_soon: Your free call with our medical coordinator starts in 1 hour
consultation_reminder.intro_title_tomorrow: Your free call with our medical coordinator starts tomorrow
consultation_reminder.intro_body: Your 15-minute video call is at {when}. Join using the video link.

visa_invitation_issued.title: Your hospital invitation letter is ready
visa_invitation_issued.body: Download the invitation letter from your documents and use it for your visa application.

intro_requested.title: New free intro call request
intro_requested.body: A visitor asked for a free 15-minute call with a medical coordinator. Please schedule it.

intro_scheduled.title: Your free call is booked
intro_scheduled.body: Your 15-minute video call with our medical coordinator is at {when}.

fx_rate_change.title: Exchange rate change for {currency} needs approval
fx_rate_change.body: {name} asked to change the {currency} rate from {old_rate} to {new_rate} INR. A second finance user must approve it before it is used for payments.

bank_details_change_requested.title: Bank transfer details change needs approval
bank_details_change_requested.body: {name} asked to change the bank account shown to patients. A second finance user must review and approve it before it takes effect.

bank_details_changed.title: Bank transfer details changed
bank_details_changed.body: The bank account shown to patients for bank transfers has been changed and approved.

agent_consent.title: Please confirm your consent
agent_consent.body: {agency} registered you on Heal India Global and confirmed that you agreed to our terms and privacy policy. Please review and confirm these consents when you sign in.

deletion_requested.title: Account deletion request
deletion_requested.body: A {role} account asked to be deleted; deletion is blocked until open items are resolved.

break_glass.title: Emergency document access
break_glass.body: {name} opened a document outside their cases. Reason: {reason}

site_enquiry.title: New website enquiry
site_enquiry.body: {name} sent an enquiry through the website contact form. Please reply within one working day.
site_enquiry.body_topic: {name} sent an enquiry through the website contact form ({topic}). Please reply within one working day.

content_report.title: New content report
content_report.body: A user reported a {target} ({reason}). Please review it in the moderation queue.

moderation_warning.title: A message from the Heal India Global team
moderation_warning.body: Our team reviewed content you posted and found that it breaks our community rules. Please keep conversations respectful and on topic. Repeated problems can lead to your account being suspended.

status.in_progress: We are working on your request.
status.awaiting_requester: We need more information from you to continue.
status.rejected: We could not carry out your request.

guardian_consent_pending.title: Guardian consent to verify
guardian_consent_pending.body: A parent or guardian gave consent for a patient under 18. Check their identity and verify it.

breach_recorded.title: Personal data breach {reference}
breach_recorded.body: {severity} severity. Notifications are due by {deadline} UTC.

inactivity_notice.title: Your account will be deleted soon
inactivity_notice.body: You have not signed in for a long time. Sign in within {days} days to keep your account; otherwise we will delete it and your data as described in our privacy policy.

review_submitted.title: New review to moderate
review_submitted.body: A patient left a {rating}-star review of {hospital}. Please check it in the review moderation queue.

review_moderated.published_body: Thank you. Your review of {hospital} is now published.
review_moderated.hidden_body: Your review of {hospital} was not published because it does not meet our review guidelines.

screening.disclaimer: This screening is an automated triage aid, not a medical diagnosis. A qualified doctor will review your case before any treatment is recommended. If your symptoms are severe or worsening, seek local medical care immediately.

rules.emergency_advice: Your answers include warning signs that may need urgent medical attention. Do not travel for treatment now - please contact your local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department immediately.
rules.summary_specialties: Based on your answers, the most relevant specialties are: {names}.
rules.summary_none: We could not map your answers to a specific specialty; a coordinator will review them.
rules.travel_urgent: Your symptoms sound significant. Have a local doctor assess you before travelling, and share their findings with the hospital.
rules.travel_routine: Bring recent reports, imaging and a list of current medicines. Plan time for recovery in India before the return flight, as advised by your treating doctor.
rules.question_options: What are my treatment options and their success rates?
rules.question_stay: How long will I need to stay in India after the procedure?
rules.question_follow_up: What follow-up care will I need at home?
